title: My True Brilliant Friend
description: Following young actresses Margherita Mazzucco and Gaia Girace on a journey that will change their lives forever, as they take on the roles of Elena and Lila in the adaptation of Elena Ferrante's bestselling quadrilogy.

title: Elli and Her Monster Team
description: A homeless ghost seeking belonging at a Ghost Train draws unwanted outside attention, forcing her and its monster residents to embark on a quest to save their home and her chance at finding family.

title: Beyond Paper
description: In the age of the virtual revolution, a filmmaker travels the world, navigating between the paper and digital realms to understand the future of human memory.

title: The Girl
description: Famed director Alfred Hitchcock obsesses over actress Tippi Hedren while filming "The Birds."

title: Faye
description: Hollywood legend Faye Dunaway candidly discusses the triumphs and challenges of her illustrious career. Through those reflections, she explores personal discoveries, including her struggles with mental health issues and bipolar disorder.

title: Irma Vep
description:
S01 E01 — The Severed Head
When disillusioned actress Mira Harberg arrives in Paris to immerse herself in the coveted role of iconic villainess Irma Vep in a remake of Feuillade's "The Vampires," an encounter with her former lover Laurie reignites dormant passions.

title: Real Time With Bill Maher
description:
S24 E33
Acerbic comic Bill Maher welcomes a panel of guests from diverse parts of the political spectrum for a lively discussion of current events, as well as offering his own perspective on contemporary issues.

title: The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
description:
S01 E01 — Chapter 1: A Body in the Bay
In 2001, a dismembered corpse is found floating in Galveston Bay, Texas and police arrest Robert Durst for the murder of his neighbor; in 2012, Robert Durst reaches out to filmmakers Andrew Jarecki and Marc Smerling and agrees to be interviewed.

title: The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
description:
S01 E02 — Chapter 2: Poor Little Rich Boy
Durst reveals details about his childhood, including witnessing his mother's suicide, and recalls how he was pressured to join his father's business; in 1982, Robert makes a report to police that his wife has gone missing.

title: The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
description:
S01 E03 — Chapter 3: The Gangster's Daughter
In 2000, a tip leads a district attorney to re-open the investigation into the disappearance of Kathie Durst; investigators begin to focus on Durst's close friend, Susan Berman, a witness who was overlooked in 1982; Susan Berman is found murdered.
